evals.prompt: Add a GET /v1/farms/{id}/area endpoint that returns the total area_m2 of all plots on the farm.
evals.expected_behavior: Implements the endpoint, adds integration tests for all cases, and the full test suite passes with 100% coverage.

assertions.description: Tests pass with 100% coverage after implementation
assertions.command: cd services/registry-service && uv sync --locked --python 3.12 && DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///registry.db uv run --no-sync python -m pytest --cov --cov-report=term -q

assertions.description: Unknown farm UUID returns 404 NOT_FOUND in problem+json
assertions.command: cd services/registry-service && DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///registry.db uv run --no-sync uvicorn main:app --port 18765 &sleep 1; curl -s -o /tmp/area_resp.json -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:18765/v1/farms/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/area; cat /tmp/area_resp.json | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['code']=='NOT_FOUND' and d['status']==404"

assertions.description: Tests cover success (farm with plots), empty farm (0 total), unknown UUID (404), malformed UUID (422), and DB unavailability (503 + Retry-After)
assertions.judge_prompt: Review the test file for GET /v1/farms/{id}/area. Does it include: (1) a farm with plots returning correct sum, (2) a farm with no plots returning 0, (3) an unknown UUID returning 404 application/problem+json with code NOT_FOUND, (4) a malformed UUID returning 422 application/problem+json with code VALIDATION, (5) a database failure returning 503 application/problem+json with code UNAVAILABLE and a Retry-After header? Cite the line numbers for each case you find. Reply YES if all five are present, NO otherwise.

evals.prompt: Explain what available_water_mm_per_m means in simple terms.
evals.expected_behavior: Skill does NOT load. Claude answers with a short conceptual explanation. No files are changed.

assertions.description: Skill does not load and no code is written or changed
assertions.judge_prompt: Did the assistant load the registry-api skill or open any project files to answer this question? If the answer is a plain conversational explanation with no file reads, tool calls, or skill loads, reply NO_SKILL_LOAD. Otherwise reply SKILL_LOADED.

assertions.description: Answer correctly explains the soil property
assertions.judge_prompt: Does the response explain that available_water_mm_per_m is the depth of water (in mm) a 1-metre column of that soil type can hold for plant use? Reply YES if the concept and units are clear, NO otherwise. Cite the sentence that shows this.

evals.expected_behavior: Agent asks for clarification instead of implementing, because the spec forbids writes on catalog routes.

assertions.description: Agent refuses or asks rather than implementing, citing the read-only catalog rule
assertions.judge_prompt: Did the assistant implement a DELETE /v1/crops/{id} endpoint, or did it decline and explain that catalog routes are read-only (returning 405 for any non-GET method)? Reply DECLINED if it refused or asked for clarification, IMPLEMENTED if it wrote code. Cite the key sentence.

assertions.description: No new files or changes were made to the service

evals.prompt: Add a PATCH /v1/plots/{id} endpoint that lets callers update just the plot name.
evals.expected_behavior: PATCH updates only the supplied field, leaves other fields unchanged, enforces uniqueness, and tests pass.

assertions.description: Full test suite passes after implementation
assertions.command: cd services/registry-service && DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///registry.db uv run --no-sync python -m pytest --cov -q

assertions.description: Implementation uses exclude_unset so omitted fields are preserved
assertions.judge_prompt: Look at the PATCH handler for /v1/plots/{id}. Does it use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) or an equivalent mechanism so that fields not in the request body are left unchanged in the database? Reply YES with the relevant line, NO otherwise.
